text:
morgan: quick heads-up — PR #8472 (fix/db-shim) needs approvals before the 11:30 PT cut. It's the runtime DB shim for dedicated, low-risk but needs two reviewers for the release gate. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8472

ash: on it, pinging infra folks and a couple of reviewers now :phone:

devon: I can do a pass in ~20m, assigning myself as reviewer.

sam: skimmed — one tiny nit in the config comment, otherwise looks fine. not blocking.

tia: infra thumbs: ran the smoke plan locally, KV warmup looks ok. leave a note when CI finishes. :white_check_mark:

morgan: test checklist in the PR description:
```
- unit tests green
- e2e smoke on staging
- DB migration no-op verified
- canary plan documented
```

deploy-bot: CI passed on branch fix/db-shim (actions/ci-run #5021) — all checks green.

ash: leaving an approval now. :thumbsup:

devon: left a review with 'approve' — small nit addressed in a follow-up commit.

jacob: second approval from me. good to go from product side.

morgan: great, we have two approvals. I will merge at 11:28 PT (2 minutes before cut) and trigger a small canary. If anything flakes we rollback immediately.

ash: ping when merged so SRE can watch the canary.

devon: noted — I'll be on watch for the next 30m.

morgan: merged at 11:28 PT. tagging canary group and starting rollout plan: https://go/release/canary/2026-03-18-8472

sam: seeing the canary instances spin up, no obvious errors in logs so far.

deploy-bot: Canary completed (no regressions detected) — metrics stable.

morgan: closing the loop — release gate satisfied, marking the hotfix as shipped. thanks everyone for quick turnaround :tada:
